name: profilehub
description: ProfileHUB - professional networking with location-based discovery and realtime chat

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:host: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev:host"
